conclusion: All 14 identified audit findings repaired and verified within the tested scope. 85 regression tests passed. Android arm64 debug APK built, installed and retained the admin session across restart. User confirmed email reset and login with the new password; runtime confirmed authenticated test identity and recovery=false. All temporary AUDIT accounts removed. iOS/system picker/offline/load limitations remain documented.

findings.title: Sesi native hilang setelah aplikasi dibuka ulang
findings.verification: AsyncStorage auth adapter, remember preference, foreground refresh, local sign-out; native force-stop/start restores admin session.

findings.title: Notifikasi perubahan proyek tidak dibuat
findings.verification: Database triggers generate project/stage/progress/file notifications; realtime publication enabled and live checks passed.

findings.title: Detail proyek lama tetap tersimpan saat permintaan detail gagal
findings.verification: Detail state cleared before fetching and on failure; stale/out-of-order requests ignored. Invalid detail checked on native runtime.

findings.title: Berkas hilang dari tampilan setelah tahap dihapus
findings.verification: Detached files and notes retrieved by project_id and displayed separately; client ownership policies corrected. Client read 2 files and 5 notes after stage deletion.

findings.title: Penghapusan proyek meninggalkan objek Storage
findings.verification: Storage recursively removed through API before project delete; database blocks direct delete while files exist. Live deletion confirmed no physical or database children remain.

findings.title: Pembuatan akun admin ditawarkan tetapi ditolak
findings.verification: Deployed admin-create-user accepts admin; all 4 roles created and authenticated successfully.

findings.title: CORS Edge Function deployed belum cocok dengan web lokal
findings.verification: Deployed OPTIONS returns localhost:8080 correctly; allowed methods and Vary header set.

findings.title: Progres 0 disimpan sebagai null
findings.verification: Nullish coalescing preserves numeric zero. Live database check passed.

findings.title: Kontrak tipe ID detail berbeda dari daftar
findings.verification: Detail IDs normalized with shared mappers; unit and live checks passed.

findings.title: Alur reset password native belum lengkap
findings.verification: Native reset screen, registered Android intent, session handling and Supabase redirects implemented. Email delivery confirmed by user. Fresh recovery link opened the installed APK; user confirmed password reset and login succeeded. Native runtime confirmed test user authenticated with recovery=false. Temporary account then removed and admin restored.

findings.title: Foto seed tidak dapat dibuka
findings.verification: Broken external seed image replaced by real private Storage object; signed download verified. New independent seed storage script added.

findings.title: Tombol bell dan bantuan Home tidak memiliki handler
findings.verification: Home bell and help handlers wired; native React handlers navigated notifications and displayed help.

findings.title: Validasi password pembuatan akun tidak konsisten
findings.verification: Both forms and Edge Function require 8 characters; ticket output uses server response.

findings.title: Pembaruan profil belum memperbarui cache pengguna
findings.verification: Profile update writes auth_user cache; authoritative profile loaded on session initialization. Native edit/cache/restore verified.

additionalFixes: Private project Storage and short-lived signed download URLs; unrelated-client access denied.
Client budget hidden at database permission/view level; staff reads through protected view.
Native file/content URI uploads use RN multipart FormData; real device cache upload content matched exactly.
Notification errors displayed with retry and owner-scoped state; duplicate subscriptions removed.
Client profile names synchronized in database; concurrent booking claims require pending status.
Detached progress records retain history through nullable FK with SET NULL.
Shared Android Gradle settings restored without signing secrets; gradlew made executable.
Support phone uses company contact constant and asynchronous Linking errors are caught.
Web recovery initial URL handled once to avoid consuming the same PKCE code twice.
Session initialization uses generations; late profile responses after sign-out or a newer initialization cannot restore the previous user. Two race regression tests passed.
